caption: The drawing consists of a single cylindrical cup centered on a plain, light beige background. The cup is rendered in pencil or graphite, with gray tones and shading depicting its three-dimensional form and metallic surface. The cup has a slightly flared rim and a narrower base, with two parallel horizontal grooves encircling its middle section and an additional thinner line near the base. The background has no additional objects or features, and a faint rectangular border frames the composition. In the bottom right corner, there is a small printed or drawn inscription: "A. ZANDENBERG."
title: Pewter Beaker
